checked: Strict raw and embedded JSON rejects duplicate keys, NaN/Infinity and exponent overflow before legacy inference helpers parse it.
Raw rows retain the complete planned cell/replication/estimator Cartesian keys and canonical order. Missing whole cells, rows or fields, duplicated methods, extra records and surplus evidence reject.
Canonical physical Cell metadata is checked with exact types and representation, including signed zero; Boolean counts/flags and integer substitutions for native floating inference values reject.

Cell manifests bind the complete contiguous partition plan, actual gzip hashes, complete schemas and recovery history. Layout checks reject unreferenced partitions, extra root artifacts and symbolic links.

Every saved source is replayed at an independently derived registered-floor anchor while retaining the actual physical floor. Wrong actual/anchor identity, seed type, coupling policy, spawn representation, source hash or spacing diagnostic rejects even after private-copy raw/epsilon bindings are rehashed.
Observed coordinates are checked against actual arrays. A mutually consistent forged point/interval offset still fails; legitimately absent triples count as absent and partial triples reject.

Known native point statuses are enforced before composing the unchanged historical inference checks. Retained source/pipeline exceptions block completion rather than being resampled or silently excluded.

All six standard tables and the 72-row, 71-column epsilon table are independently recalculated. Rehashed arithmetic corruption, false paired counts/MCSE, zero-filled mu relative metrics, duplicate comparison keys and changed epsilon directions/manifest schemas reject.

The failed-fit stream requires unique complete canonical headers, every raw field, candidate values, exact missingness, ordering and final membership. Missing/extra/reordered rows and changed numeric, Boolean, integer or nested evidence reject.

The exact dependency membership is checked after independently repairing deliberately changed provenance identity digests. Full-scope counterfeit commit/clean-list claims are rejected using actual Git bytes; these tests construct metadata only and generate no full-seed observations.
Valid audited/completed copies can be read without raw preflight or any mutation; missing audit seals reject. Whole-directory snapshots remain unchanged on ordinary success and rejection.

A saved audit must explicitly identify the floor override/contract/schema, code commit, source policy and all-source/endpoint counts. Public tests recompute the root audit hash after forging each claim, so rejection does not depend on a stale seal.

Fresh replay=False readback remains an incomplete audit, still reconstructs all sources and checks saved full-audit endpoint descriptors against verified source hashes. Fresh recomputed invariant fields cannot be replaced by an old generic audit report.

Persistent external root or existing audit-artifact drift during verification raises without overwriting, restoring or creating incident artifacts. Complete before/after scope includes lifecycle files as well as numerical artifacts.
